premises.evidence_span: The difference from air cooling or water cooling that's used today, this can allow us to go below ambient. That means we can go below room temperature, and there is no cooling system in the market that can do that today

premises.text: Company developed a two-phase cooling system integrated into a drop-in standard data-center server that acts like a fridge on the CPU
